chunks: From him, from Jaʿfar, from Muthannā, from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“Perform the ʿAṣr salat at four qadam.” Muthannā said: Abū Baṣīr said to me: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me, “Perform the ʿAṣr salat on Friday at six qadam.”

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةِ أَقْدَامٍ: four qadam, a measure indicating prayer time
key_terms.سِتَّةِ أَقْدَامٍ: six qadam, a measure indicating prayer time on Friday

ai.seo_question: When should the ʿAṣr salat be performed, and does its time differ on Friday?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the timing of the ʿAṣr salat. It states that ʿAṣr is to be performed at four qadam, while on Friday it is performed at six qadam, indicating a distinction in prayer timing for Yawm al-Jumuʿah.
